messages:
elaine: Heads-up  folks - found two broken links in the Sealed-site installer guide after the recent TOC reorg. Also hearing requests for a tiny Go SDK example showing kms transport over unix socket for air-gapped installs. Can we patch and add both in one quick PR?

rajesh: I can do the link fixes. The broken anchors are `/sealedsite/install#networking` -> changed to `/sealedsite/install#networking-overview` and one in the checksums section. I'll add short anchor alias comments so redirects don't break later.

tony: I'll add the Go snippet + a short note about verifying the offline bundle checksum. For the Go SDK example, propose this minimal snippet: 
```go
// go example: override KMS transport for airgapped installer
package main

import (
  "context"
  "log"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go"
)

func main() {
  cfg := redwood.DefaultConfig()
  cfg.KMSTransport = "unix"
  cfg.KMSSocket = "/var/run/kms.sock"
  client, err := redwood.NewClient(cfg)
  if err != nil { log.Fatalf("client: %v", err) }
  ctx := context.Background()
  _ = client.HealthCheck(ctx)
}
```

elaine: Nice. Can you also add a one-liner for systemd units to ensure the pkcs11 socket is created with right ownership? Common issue is installer can't access the socket.

tony: Adding this note: `ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood-installer:installer /var/run/pkcs11.sock && /bin/chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock` in the systemd example. And a 1-sentence explanation: "PKCS11 sockets must be owned by the installer user or readable by the group used during install."

rajesh: For checksum verification, I'll append the minimal commands: `sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz` and compare with the published value. Add a short tip about using `gpg --verify` if they also have the signature.

docbot: link-checker: 2 broken links detected in /sealedsite/install.md (networking, checksums) - flagged.

tony: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 - includes anchor aliases, go snippet, systemd permission note, checksum commands, and small prose on unix vs tcp KMS transport.

elaine: Quick editorial: keep the Go snippet under 25 lines, and please mark the systemd line as optional (many customers use other init systems). Also add a short callout: "If using TCP transport, ensure the KMS host:port is reachable from the sealed network and firewall rules allow the connection."

rajesh: Done. Also added a micro-migration entry in the migration guide: "When renaming headings prefer stable IDs or add alias anchors to preserve external links."

docbot: netlify-preview: https://deploy-preview-812--docs.redwood.ai - preview deployed, link checks re-run.

elaine: Verified preview - anchors resolve and Go snippet renders correctly. One nit: code fence language is `go` not `golang` - fixed in branch.

tony: CI green, all link-check warnings resolved. Merging in 5.

elaine: Merged. Thanks y'all. Closing thread. :tada:
